subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to confirm your upcoming flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th. Your reservation is confirmed under the name [Passenger Name], and your flight details are as follows: Flight Number: AB123, Departure Time: 10:00 AM, Arrival Time: 1:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airlines Team
